_readme: CI-only baseline of KNOWN, already-hand-verified `aep security` findings in this repository - never a change to AEP's own scanner or detection logic. Every entry here is either (a) a FAKE placeholder credential in a test fixture or a docs/BUGFIX.md entry describing a past fake-credential incident by name, or (b) a scanner-pattern reference inside src/aep/redaction.py itself, or (c) the intentional demo-fixture placeholder key in src/aep/demo_template/config.py that the real CEO demo scenario deliberately triggers and then fixes. None are real secrets - see BUGFIX.md and handoff.md for the full manual review. .github/workflows/ci.yml fails the build only on a finding NOT in this list (file+rule+line) - a genuinely new, unreviewed finding - never on one of these. Regenerate by re-running `aep security . --json` and re-deriving this file only after manually confirming any new/changed entry is not a real secret.
